name: Coldseam Retired Spire Slummer's Shelf Day Set
description: A bespoke Coldseam overcoat — once Φ4,000 worth of pressed wool-analog and chrome-thread piping — now patched at both elbows with Shelf-grade duct tape and re-hemmed with mismatched thread. Worn over a stained Tier 3 dress shirt with the collar button missing and synth-leather trousers gone gray at the knees. The shoes are still Caelum IX pressure-forms, which is the tell.
functionality: Still structurally weatherproof despite damage; deep interior pockets retain their hidden lining compartments.
what_it_says: Someone who fell very far, very fast — and still hasn't let go of who they were.
worn_by: burned fixers with old money habits
manufacturer: Coldseam (original); Shelf repairs by unknown hands
story_hooks: The coat's interior lining still has an encrypted Spire access chip sewn into the hem — its owner doesn't know it still works.
Someone on the Shelf recognizes the chrome-thread piping pattern and knows exactly which corponation this person used to run.
